scoring.publicLabel: Provisional project ranking - not an official QS or THE ranking

coverageRules.label: High confidence
coverageRules.treatment: Strict validated rank may be published.

coverageRules.label: Medium confidence
coverageRules.treatment: Strict result may be published with a confidence label.

coverageRules.label: Provisional strict result
coverageRules.treatment: Strict provisional score without an ordinal rank.

coverageRules.label: Below strict threshold
coverageRules.treatment: No strict score or rank; method 1.1 may still show a coverage-adjusted provisional rank.

statusDefinitions.verified: Current official source directly supports the displayed value.
statusDefinitions.manual-review: Source evidence exists, but value or scope still requires review.
statusDefinitions.unverified: The programme identity or eligibility is unresolved.
statusDefinitions.not-stated: The reviewed source did not state a usable value.
statusDefinitions.not-ranked: Not ranked in the collected complete official table (NR).
statusDefinitions.not-published: The ranking edition was not published (N/P).
statusDefinitions.not-collected: The source was not collected or a usable value was not captured.
statusDefinitions.insufficient-evidence: Coverage is below the documented publication threshold.
statusDefinitions.provisional-ranking: Coverage-adjusted method 1.1 output. It is not a strict validated final result.
statusDefinitions.eligibility-excluded: The record is excluded from the provisional ranking because programme eligibility is unresolved or invalid.
